$comment: One record per source in this directory. scripts/check-curation.sh fails CI when a built package differs from its record. payloadSha256 is the SHA-256 of Payload/main.wasm inside the .aix (the zip itself embeds build timestamps, so its hash is not stable). contentLicense (SPDX-style) is copied into the published index entry by scripts/build.sh; Aidoku parsers ignore unknown fields.

entries.sourceLicence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the Rust source in this repository)

content.work: Pepper&Carrot webcomic, episodes 1-39 (the 'episodes.json' list published by the author)
content.basis: The author's licence page states that comics, translations and artworks are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, and the official API documentation offers the episode images for reuse under CC BY (https://www.peppercarrot.com/en/license/index.html, https://www.peppercarrot.com/ld/documentation/130_API.html). Not covered: the separate MiniFantasyTheater strips (CC BY-SA 4.0) and fan-art, neither of which the source lists.
content.restrictions: The author's licence notice states 'AI derivation prohibited'. The source only reads the episodes; it does not train or derive anything.
content.note: CC BY 4.0, shown unmodified with per-language attribution. On 2026-10-08 the author published a statement (https://www.davidrevoy.com/article1178/license-update-ai-derivation-prohibited-on-all-my-art-lore-stories-and-comics) prohibiting AI-generated derivative works while tolerating AI for grammar, proofreading and translation. nemu never generates derivatives; its learning features (OCR, explanation) are reading aids the user starts. The entry is removed if the author objects. Verified 2026-10-12.

entries.name: NDL Public Domain Picks
entries.sourceLicence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the Rust source in this repository)

content.work: Seven works picked by hand from the National Diet Library Digital Collections; the list is sources/ja.ndlpublicdomain/src/works.json. Nothing else in NDL's collection is reachable through the source.
content.licensor: Not applicable: the works are out of copyright. Scans by the National Diet Library, Japan.
content.basis: NDL's reuse page says content marked インターネット公開（保護期間満了）"is in the public domain and may be reused freely" with no application (https://www.ndl.go.jp/en/use/reproduction/index.html). NDL's IIIF help, which each manifest's license field links to, says the IIIF API only serves such items and that its images "may be reproduced or repurposed without permission from the NDL" (https://dl.ndl.go.jp/ja/help_iiif#api-%E3%81%AE%E5%88%A9%E7%94%A8%E3%81%AB%E3%81%A4%E3%81%84%E3%81%A6). NDL decides this status under Japanese law, so each work here was also checked for worldwide status: every creator died in or before 1920, and every work was published before 1931.
content.restrictions: NDL asks reusers to credit it and to consider moral rights, human rights and privacy, and leaves responsibility for reuse with the reuser (section 3 of the reuse page). NDL asks that the status of each image be checked; the source reads each volume's manifest when it is opened and shows nothing unless it still says PDM.
content.note: The source does not call the NDL Search API, whose metadata terms ask commercial users to apply (https://ndlsearch.ndl.go.jp/en/help/api). Checked with scripts/check-public-domain.py. Verified 2026-11-08.

entries.name: Little Nemo in Slumberland
entries.sourceLicence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the Rust source in this repository)

content.work: Little Nemo in Slumberland by Winsor McCay, 261 dated Sunday strips from 1905-1911; the list is sources/en.littlenemo/src/strips.tsv, taken from the Wikimedia Commons categories 'Little Nemo in Slumberland, <year>'.
content.licensor: Not applicable: the work is out of copyright. Scans by Wikimedia Commons contributors.
content.basis: McCay died in 1934, so the strips are out of copyright in life+70 countries, and they were published before 1931, so they are out of copyright in the US. Each listed file was checked through the Commons API: extmetadata License=pd, Copyrighted=False, and a PD-* licence template in its wikitext. Each file's evidence is on its own Commons page.
content.restrictions: None from copyright. The source re-reads each file's License when a chapter is opened and drops any that is no longer pd. Requests carry the User-Agent that Wikimedia's policy asks for (https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Wikimedia_Foundation_User-Agent_Policy) and ask for a standard thumbnail width.
content.note: Some strips contain racist caricatures of the period, including the character Imp; the work's description says so. Not every week is on Commons: the list has 48 strips for 1906, 15 for 1910 and 30 for 1911. 1905-12-03 is only a 700 px scan. Checked with scripts/check-public-domain.py. Verified 2026-11-08.
